settings.text: The pneumatic glass pressing table is equipped with two high-power cylinders. Using 360-degree rotating rollers and high-quality, fully standardized components, it efficiently presses double- and triple-glazed glass units.

settings.title: Introducing the Pneumatic Glass Pressing Table
settings.text:
Various machines are used in double-glazed glass production, each performing a specific task.
Some machines carry out more critical operations, so workshops should ensure that these are of high quality.
The pneumatic glass pressing table is one of the essential machines required in a double-glazed glass production line.
This pneumatic pressing table can produce a double-glazed glass unit in less than 20 seconds without using additional materials such as aluminium spacers or requiring a desiccant.
In fact, using modern technology, it can produce high-quality double-glazed glass with minimal time and cost, without requiring skilled labour, and with a reliable warranty.

settings.title: Technical Specifications of the Pneumatic Pressing Table
settings.text:
The pneumatic glass pressing table is an essential component of double-glazed glass production lines. Its absence may have a significant impact on the final product quality.
If you need a pneumatic pressing table, it is useful to become familiar with its specifications and features so you can choose the right model from the wide range available.
The key technical specifications that make this pneumatic glass pressing table noteworthy include:
The machine measures 2 × 2 metres.
All rollers fitted to the machine for moving glass are highly durable and can support the weight of large glass sheets without damage.
Wear-resistant UCP rubber components are used in various sections to ensure long service life, even during extended operation.
All components of the table can be detached and transported easily, and the table can also be assembled with ease.
The machine body is made of high-quality metal and coated with oven-cured electrostatic powder paint, helping prevent rust and corrosion in humid environments.
The table is fitted with 360-degree rotating rollers, allowing glass to be moved easily across its surface without disrupting the workflow.
Two powerful pneumatic cylinders provide the pressure required for pressing double- and triple-glazed glass units.
The press is lightweight and easy to move around the workshop. All operating stages can also be controlled using a single pedal.

settings.title: Why Use a Pneumatic Glass Press?
settings.text:
Today, glass is manufactured in various forms: some types are tinted, others are clear, and some are reflective.
Using glass correctly and appropriately offers many benefits. Modern machines and technologies are therefore employed to improve glass production.
Understanding the properties and features of double-glazed glass helps explain the importance of using a pneumatic glass press:
Reduced heating and cooling energy loss
Reduced noise pollution
Prevention of condensation during rainy weather
Greater resistance to solar ultraviolet radiation and its harmful effects
Improved safety compared with ordinary glass
Prevention of dust entering indoor spaces
Non-combustibility and ease of installation

settings.title: Key Features of the Pneumatic Glass Pressing Table
settings.text:
Glass panes are generally placed on the pneumatic pressing table one at a time and pressed using the pneumatic pedal. During pressing, argon gas can also be injected into the glass unit, where it remains sealed inside.
The pneumatic glass pressing table is undoubtedly one of the leading machines used in double-glazed glass production.
Since the machine requires only a general operator, it significantly reduces the labour costs associated with double-glazed glass production.
Compared with other models on the market, this machine offers notable features that help improve the production process.
Some of the most important features of the pneumatic glass pressing table include:
Easy glass production and simple machine operation are among its key advantages.
It does not require specialized or highly skilled personnel to operate.
The machine operates without three-phase power and uses standard single-phase household electricity, making it easy to use in a wide range of settings.
Its ability to press glass within minutes increases production speed in workshops.
Once pressed, the glass remains in place on the table surface, an important safety advantage.
It is equipped with high-quality, standard-compliant components.
Pressing can be performed without additional tools or equipment, reducing many associated costs.
The 18-month three-star Gold Warranty reflects the manufacturer's confidence in the machine's quality.
After-sales service and the supply of parts and spare components for 360 months further demonstrate the manufacturer's confidence in the product.
